claim_text: The Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle touched down on the lunar surface in 1969.
Gustave Eiffel built the Eiffel Tower in Berlin Germany during the 17th century.
Photosynthesis takes place in chloroplast organelles containing chlorophyll to capture light energy.
Guido van Rossum invented the Python language focusing on code readability.
General relativity was established by Albert Einstein in 1915 to formulate gravitation as spacetime curvature.
The Great Wall of China protected northern borders and began during the Qin dynasty.
The discovery of the double helix structure of DNA occurred in 1953 with Watson Crick Franklin and Wilkins.
Alan Turing invented the Turing machine computation model in 1936.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth with its summit on the border of China and Nepal.
Alexander Fleming identified penicillin in 1928 after observing mold lysis in a bacterial culture.
Deep Blue defeated chess champion Garry Kasparov in 1997.
Saturn's rings are composed mainly of water ice particles.
CRISPR-Cas9 acts as a programmable genome editing system derived from bacterial defense mechanisms.
The point-contact transistor was created in 1947 by Shockley Bardeen and Brattain at Bell Labs.
Albert Einstein won five Oscars for directing Hollywood silent movies in the 1920s.
